items.followUp: What precautions should you take before making an online payment?

rubric.why: Using a trusted, secure service reduces the risk of fraudulent transactions.
rubric.description: Use a trusted and secure website or payment service.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for advising the student to use a trusted, secure website or payment service.

rubric.why: Keeping sensitive credentials and payment information private helps prevent misuse.
rubric.description: Do not share passwords, OTPs or payment-card details.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for advising the student not to share sensitive account or payment information.

modelAnswer: Make online transactions only through trusted, secure websites or payment services.
Never share your password, OTP or payment-card details with anyone.

items.followUp: Give an example of a nested list in Python and explain why it is nested.

rubric.why: A nested list is defined by a list occurring as an element of another list.
rubric.description: Defines a nested list as a list containing another list.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that a list contains another list or has a list inside it.

rubric.why: The example has inner lists as elements of an outer list.
rubric.description: Provides a valid example of a nested list.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for giving a correct nested-list example.

modelAnswer: A nested list is a list that contains another list as one or more of its elements.
